<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex25501a2023-01-2316-16-43" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon"> <milestone unit="section" n="SP's Colophon (4a4–4b1)"/>
               <rs type="work" ref="db:3775" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">'brel pa brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa</rs> ¦ <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3773">slob dpon mkhas pa chen po chos kyi <abbr>grags</abbr> pa</rs>s mdzad pa rdzogs s+ho ||
               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3730"><rs type="place" ref="db:5558">rgya gar</rs> gyi mkhan <pb n="4b"/><lb n="4b1"/> po dz+nyA na gar+b+ha</rs> dang ¦ <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5561">lo tsa ba ban+de nam mkha</rs>s bsgyur ||
            <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5563"><rs type="place" ref="db:5558">rgya gar</rs> gyi mkhan po dpal rab 'byor zhi ba</rs>'i zhal bzhus dang ¦ <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5562">zhu chen gyi lo tsa ba dge slong ting 'dzin bzang po</rs>s zhu chen bgyis te gtan la phab zer | </note></seg></TEI>
